title: Bounded monomial spanning
statement: Let k be a field, d,m natural numbers, h in R=k[X_0,...,X_{d-1}], and p_i a monic polynomial over k[X_0,...,X_{d+i}] of natural degree e_i. Let Q be the simultaneous quotient by hT-1 and the triangular p_i, and D=Localization.Away h. Suppose psi:D→ₐ[k]Q agrees on R with the canonical renamed quotient map. For every q in Q there is a D-valued function c on bounded exponent tuples such that q equals the sum over a of psi(c(a)) times product_i [Y_i]^(a_i). Zero h, zero degrees, and m=0 are allowed.

source.place: Proof of Tag 07BV, first assertion, triangular minimal polynomials and denominator clearing; Tag 08JZ, localization presentation. Read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07BV and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08JZ because the local literature checkout is absent.

proof.text: Let S be the D-submodule spanned by the bounded monomials, with D acting through psi. The localization relation gives hT=1. Applying psi to h(1/h)=1 and using hpsi shows T=psi(1/h) by uniqueness of a multiplicative inverse.

Prove closure of S under multiplication by Y_i by strong induction on i. Assuming closure for earlier variables, multivariate polynomial induction proves closure under multiplication by the image of any coefficient polynomial of p_i: X variables and T are D-scalars, and earlier Y variables use the induction hypothesis. The quotient relation p_i(Y_i)=0 and monicity express Y_i^(e_i) as minus the sum of the lower powers times the coefficient images. For each bounded monomial, split off its Y_i factor by the finite product over all other variables. Multiplication by Y_i either increments its exponent within the bound, or reaches e_i and uses this relation. Each resulting bounded monomial times a coefficient lies in S by the coefficient-closure induction. Extend this from bounded monomials to their span by Submodule.span_induction. This is the private proved helper triangularFieldModel_bounded_mul.

Show 1 belongs to S. If some e_i=0, monicity makes p_i=1, so 1=0 in the quotient and the claim follows. Otherwise the all-zero bounded exponent tuple gives 1. Thus psi(D) lies in S. The previous step, the localization identity and hpsi show closure under multiplication by every quotient variable. MvPolynomial.induction_on gives membership for every polynomial image; quotient-map surjectivity gives membership for every q. Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun extracts the coefficient function c and its sum, with scalar multiplication definitionally psi(c)*monomial.

proof_origin.place: Tags 07BV and 08JZ (read online); direct triangular monic reduction and polynomial induction, fully formalized.

lean.statement:
theorem triangularFieldModel_bounded_spanning
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (d m : ℕ) (h : MvPolynomial (Fin d) k)
    (p : (i : Fin m) → Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + i.val)) k))
    (e : Fin m → ℕ) (hp : ∀ i, (p i).Monic)
    (he : ∀ i, (p i).natDegree = e i)
    (psi : Localization.Away h →ₐ[k]
      (MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + m)) k ⧸
        Ideal.ofList (triangularFieldModelEquations k d m h p)))
    (hpsi : ∀ r : MvPolynomial (Fin d) k,
      psi (algebraMap _ (Localization.Away h) r) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _
        (MvPolynomial.rename (fun j : Fin d ↦
          (⟨j.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 1 + m))) r))
    (q : (MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + m)) k ⧸
        Ideal.ofList (triangularFieldModelEquations k d m h p))) :
    ∃ c : (((i : Fin m) → Fin (e i)) → Localization.Away h), (∑ a : ((i : Fin m) → Fin (e i)),
        psi (c a) * (∏ i : Fin m,
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.X
            (⟨d + 1 + i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 1 + m)))) ^ (a i).val)) = q
